jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer - Machine Learning Ops
jobs.description:
Systems Software Engineer — Machine Learning Ops

About The Role

What if your systems engineering skills could directly shape the infrastructure powering the world's most advanced AI models? We're looking for a senior C++ engineer to build and optimize the data pipelines, annotation tooling, and evaluation systems that leading AI labs depend on to train and ship next-generation models.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role for a seasoned engineer who knows C++ deeply and thrives working on high-impact, production-grade systems. If you've spent years writing performance-critical code and want to apply that expertise at the cutting edge of AI development, this is the role for you.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 20–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Design, build, and optimize high-performance C++ systems supporting AI data pipelines and evaluation workflows
Develop full-stack tooling and backend services for large-scale data annotation, validation, and quality control
Improve reliability, performance, and safety across existing C++ codebases used in production AI environments
Collaborate with data, research, and engineering teams to support model training and evaluation workflows
Identify bottlenecks and edge cases in data and system behavior, and implement scalable, maintainable fixes
Participate in synchronous design reviews to iterate on system architecture and implementation decisions

Who You Are

Native or fluent English speaker with clear written and verbal communication skills
Full-stack developer with a strong systems programming background and deep C++ expertise
5+ years of professional experience writing production C++ code
Experienced working with the C++ frontends of ML frameworks or inference runtimes
Familiar with hardware acceleration APIs for optimizing model inference
Able to commit 20–40 hours per week with consistency and reliability

Nice to Have

Prior experience with data annotation, data quality pipelines, or evaluation systems
Familiarity with AI/ML workflows, model training, or benchmarking pipelines
Experience with distributed systems design or developer tooling
Background in performance profiling, debugging, or systems reliability engineering

Why Join Us

Work on real production systems used by leading AI research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, impactful technical work
Contribute directly to infrastructure that shapes the future of AI development
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
We empower smarter business operations by connecting equipment, software, and services to protect, control and optimize assets within electrical infrastructures. The business provides customers, across various industries, with end-to-end product and service solutions ensuring the reliability and protection of their electrical infrastructure. We provide the latest industry insights and technology to develop solutions needed to meet customers evolving challenges, including innovative critical power solutions designed for high reliability and performance. Our culture is one of quality and operational excellence fueled and supported by talented people, tools and processes, and expertise.

To return to the OmniOn Power website, click here.

The Quality Assurance Specialist is responsible for auditing engineering specifications and engineering packages to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to customer standards and requirements. Maintains Cost of Quality tracking for quotation, engineering, execution and material. Supports Method of Procedure and End of Job reviews, quality and compliance reporting, including TL 9000 metric support, and internal surveillance audits. This role will report to the Services Quality Leader and will be 100% remote.

Duties/Responsibilities

As the Quality Assurance Specialist, you will:

Audit engineering specifications for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to customer standards; document findings and drive timely correction/closure.
Audit engineering packages (drawings, BOMs, build documentation, ECNs/changes, deviations, and supporting records) to verify compliance with customer requirements and internal procedures.
Audit Methods of Procedure and End of Job packages to ensure safe installation practices, compliance with customer and regulatory requirements, and quality of work performed
Ensure version control and configuration alignment between customer requirements, released engineering documentation, and service deliverables.
Tracking of cost of poor-quality (CoPQ) metrics and communicating to quotations, engineering and execution team supporting in corrective action implementation to drive reduction in cost of quality and customer satisfaction.
Identify gaps, errors, and nonconformities; initiate corrective actions and partner with Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Operations to implement fixes and prevent recurrence.
Support TL 9000 metric collection, validation, and reporting for applicable service categories; provide inputs and summaries to stakeholders as required.
Support internal surveillance audits by preparing audit checklists, gathering objective evidence, conducting process interviews, recording results, and tracking corrective actions to closure.
Prepare audit summaries, trend analyses, and dashboards; communicate recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
Maintain audit records, trackers, and evidence in accordance with document retention, confidentiality, and customer-specific requirements.

Basic Qualifications

Completion of high school diploma or GED
5 years of experience in telecom industry requirements including but not limited to DC power installation/engineering, toll/fiber installation, project management, etc.
Experience auditing engineering documentation (specifications, drawings, BOMs, and/or engineering change documentation) for accuracy and compliance.
Working knowledge of quality management systems and audit practices (e.g., TL9000/ISO 9001 concepts, internal auditing, corrective action).
Ability to interpret customer requirements, standards, and contractual engineering deliverables.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and SharePoint (including formulas, pivot tables, and basic data analysis) for tracker maintenance and Cost of Quality calculations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document clear, objective audit evidence and findings.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through; able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Desired Qualifications

Familiarity with TL 9000 measurements and reporting processes.
Experience with ERP/MRP, PLM/PDM, or document control systems used to manage engineering releases.
Understanding of Cost of Poor Quality (CoPQ) categories and basic cost accounting concepts.
Prior participation in internal surveillance audits or customer audits within manufacturing, repair, or service environments.
Certification or training in internal auditing (e.g., ISO 9001 Internal Auditor).

ELIGIBILTY REQUIREMENTS:
OmniOn Power will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

jobs.title: .NET Developer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Halvik Corp
delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special!

Position Overview

The contractor shall serve as the primary .NET Core Backend Developer, responsible for designing, developing, testing, and configuring applications within the Azure cloud environment. This role focuses exclusively on modern .NET Core technologies to build and optimize scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs that support enterprise‑grade solutions. The developer will implement cloud‑ready architectures, apply clean coding practices, ensure high‑performance service design, and deliver secure, maintainable, and resilient backend components for mission‑critical applications.

Core Responsibilities

Develop Web Applications: Using .NET Aspire technologies to build robust and scalable web applications.
Participate in Architectural Discussions: Working with the GPO IT and project teams to develop application architecture and ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment.
Environment Setup: Standing up all environments, including development, staging/test, production, and COOP.
Maintain Applications: Developing and maintaining front-end and back-end applications and services.
Implement Modules: Integrating third-party modules and developing custom modules according to GPO's needs.
Manage Code Versioning and Deployments: Following GPO's configuration management policies for code versioning and deployments.
Security Implementation: Making code or system changes to address GPO security recommendations.
Documentation: Creating and maintaining detailed technical support, high-level design, and detailed design documents.
Testing: Conducting multiple levels of testing, including unit, system, integration, performance, and load testing.
User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Assisting with UAT, recording, and implementing changes resulting from UAT.
Defect Management: Participating in defect management discussion with the project management team to ensure defects are tracked and remedied.
Progress Reporting: Communicating progress and/or schedule delays to GPO with efficiency and accuracy.
Iterative Updates: Making iterative updates to deliverables as needed throughout the agile process.

Minimum Requirements

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science recommended, but not required
Experience: 2-5+ years recent experience as a senior .Net Developer
Technical Proficiency: .NET to build robust and scalable web applications
Compliance: N/A

Preferred Expertise

Demonstrated success in Federal Contracting recommended.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Privacy Policy – Halvik Corp

Halvik Offers a Competitive Full Benefits Package Including

Company-supported medical, dental, vision, life, STD, and LTD insurance

Benefits include 11 federal holidays and PTO

Eligible employees may receive performance-based incentives in recognition of individual and/or team achievements.

401(k) with company matching

Flexible Spending Accounts for commuter, medical, and dependent care expenses

Tuition Assistance

Charitable Contribution matching

Halvik Corp is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Halvik's pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

jobs.title: AI QA Engineer, Part-Time AI Model Evaluation - Remote (United States)
jobs.description:
• $63–$120 per hour
• 100% remote
• Part-time
• About 1–3 hours a week, you choose when

Work on the cutting edge of AI, on your own schedule, and get paid for the quality assurance judgment you already have.

The AI systems everyone is talking about are trained and tested by real quality assurance professionals. The teams building them need people who can compare reference materials with AI answers, assess those answers using project instructions, record the evidence for each decision, and point out where the system falls short. Your judgment helps improve how the next generation of AI models behaves. This is that work, done remotely around your current job.

What you'll do
• Judge AI-generated answers against the project's scoring criteria
• Compare reference materials with AI answers while following the project's instructions
• Record the evidence for each decision and state why you reached it
• Give feedback to improve model behavior while applying the same standard from one review task to the next

Why this is worth your time
• Get paid $63–$120 an hour to build real AI skills, on top of your current job
• Work directly with frontier AI tools and see how they are built, tested and improved, experience most software quality assurance professionals will not have for years
• Build a career edge for what comes next: AI is reshaping software quality assurance, and the people who understand it from the inside will lead that change
• Fully remote, fully flexible, no minimum shift, no commute

Who this is for
• Strong knowledge of software quality assurance in practice
• Experience planning tests and reporting defects
• English proficiency at B2 level or higher
• No AI experience needed. You bring the expertise; we bring the training on the tools.

Pay and details
• $63–$120 per hour, paid hourly as an independent contractor
• About 1–3 hours a week, you choose when; fully remote, United States

How to apply
1. Apply on OpenTrain (about two minutes; upload your resume).
2. Complete a short application on the hiring platform.
3. If shortlisted, take a short AI interview. Most people hear back within days.
